THALLIKI-VANDANAM.answer_te:
తల్లికి వందనం (గతంలో అమ్మ ఒడి) అర్హత:
• తల్లి/సంరక్షకురాలు ఉండాలి
• పిల్లలు 1-12 తరగతి చదువుతుండాలి
• 75% attendance ఉండాలి
• Rice card ఉండాలి
• Rural: ₹10,000/నెల income లోపు; Urban: ₹12,000/నెల
• భూమి: < 3 ఎకరాలు wet / < 10 ఎకరాలు dry
• Electricity: < 300 units/నెల

Excluded: Four-wheeler owners, Govt employees, Income tax payees, ITI/Polytechnic/RGUKT students
THALLIKI-VANDANAM.answer_en: Thalliki Vandanam (formerly Amma Vodi) eligibility: Mother/guardian with children in classes 1-12, 75% attendance, rice card, Rural income ≤ ₹10,000/month or Urban ≤ ₹12,000/month, land < 3 acres wet / < 10 acres dry, electricity < 300 units/month. Excluded: four-wheeler owners, govt employees, IT payees.

THALLIKI-VANDANAM.answer_te: తల్లికి వందనం: ₹15,000 ప్రతి పిల్లవాడికి సంవత్సరానికి. DBT ద్వారా mother's Aadhaar-seeded bank account లో credit.
THALLIKI-VANDANAM.question_en: How much money in Thalliki Vandanam?
THALLIKI-VANDANAM.answer_en: ₹15,000 per child per year. Paid via DBT to mother's Aadhaar-seeded bank account.

THALLIKI-VANDANAM.question_te: తల్లికి వందనం కి ఏ documents కావాలి?
THALLIKI-VANDANAM.answer_te:
తల్లికి వందనం documents:
• తల్లి Aadhaar card
• పిల్లల Aadhaar card
• School enrollment certificate
• Rice card
• Bank passbook (తల్లి Aadhaar-linked account)
THALLIKI-VANDANAM.question_en: What documents needed for Thalliki Vandanam?
THALLIKI-VANDANAM.answer_en: Mother's Aadhaar, children's Aadhaar, school enrollment certificate, rice card, bank passbook (mother's Aadhaar-linked account).

THALLIKI-VANDANAM.answer_te: అవును, YSR అమ్మ ఒడి పేరు 'తల్లికి వందనం' గా మారింది. 12 జూన్ 2025 న relaunch చేయబడింది. Benefits అదే — ₹15,000/సంవత్సరం. కానీ eligibility criteria strict అయ్యాయి — income limits, land limits, electricity checks add అయ్యాయి.
THALLIKI-VANDANAM.answer_en: Yes, YSR Amma Vodi was renamed to 'Thalliki Vandanam' and relaunched on 12 June 2025. Same ₹15,000/year benefit but stricter eligibility: income limits, land limits, and electricity consumption checks added.

THALLIKI-VANDANAM.question_te: తల్లికి వందనం private school కి వర్తిస్తుందా?
THALLIKI-VANDANAM.answer_te: అవును, తల్లికి వందనం govt, private aided/unaided, మరియు recognized junior colleges కి వర్తిస్తుంది. Un-recognized schools కి వర్తించదు.
THALLIKI-VANDANAM.question_en: Does Thalliki Vandanam apply to private schools?
THALLIKI-VANDANAM.answer_en: Yes, Thalliki Vandanam applies to govt, private aided/unaided, and recognized junior colleges. Not applicable to unrecognized schools.

ANNADATA-SUKHIBHAVA.answer_te:
అన్నదాత సుఖీభవ (గతంలో రైతు భరోసా) అర్హత:
• వ్యవసాయ భూమి ఉన్న రైతు (pattadar)
• Tenant farmers కూడా eligible (CCRC తో)
• AP permanent resident
• PM-KISAN లో registered

Excluded: IT payees, Govt employees, ₹10,000+ pension, < 10 cents land, minors land
ANNADATA-SUKHIBHAVA.answer_en: Annadata Sukhibhava (formerly Rythu Bharosa): Must own agricultural land or be tenant farmer with CCRC, AP resident, PM-KISAN registered. Excluded: IT payees, govt employees, pensioners > ₹10K/month.

ANNADATA-SUKHIBHAVA.answer_te:
అన్నదాత సుఖీభవ: ₹20,000/సంవత్సరం (పెరిగింది!)
• 1st installment: ₹7,000 (August)
• 2nd installment: ₹7,000 (November)
• 3rd installment: ₹6,000 (March/Ugadi)

గతంలో రైతు భరోసా ₹13,500 ఉండేది — ఇప్పుడు ₹20,000 కి పెరిగింది.
ANNADATA-SUKHIBHAVA.question_en: How much money in Annadata Sukhibhava?
ANNADATA-SUKHIBHAVA.answer_en: ₹20,000/year (increased from ₹13,500 under Rythu Bharosa). 3 installments: ₹7,000 (Aug) + ₹7,000 (Nov) + ₹6,000 (Mar/Ugadi). Also includes seeds, fertilizers, and calamity insurance.

ANNADATA-SUKHIBHAVA.answer_te: అవును, YSR రైతు భరోసా పేరు 'అన్నదాత సుఖీభవ' గా మారింది. 2 ఆగస్ట్ 2025 న launch. మొత్తం ₹13,500 నుండి ₹20,000 కి పెరిగింది. PM-KISAN auto-enrollment.
ANNADATA-SUKHIBHAVA.answer_en: Yes, YSR Rythu Bharosa was renamed to 'Annadata Sukhibhava' launched 2 Aug 2025. Amount increased from ₹13,500 to ₹20,000/year. Auto-enrolled from PM-KISAN list.

ANNADATA-SUKHIBHAVA.answer_te: అవును, కౌలు రైతులు (tenant farmers) కూడా eligible. Valid CCRC (Crop Cultivator Rights Card) ఉండాలి. VRO/Agriculture Assistant ద్వారా CCRC apply చేయండి.
ANNADATA-SUKHIBHAVA.question_en: Do tenant farmers get Annadata Sukhibhava?
ANNADATA-SUKHIBHAVA.answer_en: Yes, tenant farmers are also eligible with valid CCRC (Crop Cultivator Rights Card). Apply for CCRC through VRO/Agriculture Assistant.

DR-NTR-VAIDYA-SEVA.question_te: డాక్టర్ NTR వైద్య సేవ అర్హత ఏమిటి?
DR-NTR-VAIDYA-SEVA.answer_te:
డాక్టర్ NTR వైద్య సేవ (గతంలో ఆరోగ్యశ్రీ) అర్హత:
• White ration card (BPL) Aadhaar linked
• కుటుంబ ఆదాయం ₹5 లక్షల లోపు
• AP permanent resident
• < 35 ఎకరాలు total land
• ₹25 లక్షల వరకు cashless treatment
• 949+ treatments cover

Excluded: Govt employees with medical reimbursement, ESIC beneficiaries
DR-NTR-VAIDYA-SEVA.question_en: What is Dr. NTR Vaidya Seva eligibility?
DR-NTR-VAIDYA-SEVA.answer_en: Dr. NTR Vaidya Seva (formerly Aarogyasri): White ration card (BPL), income below 5 lakhs, AP resident, land < 35 acres. Covers 949+ treatments up to ₹25 lakhs. Being integrated with Ayushman Bharat.

DR-NTR-VAIDYA-SEVA.answer_te: అవును, YSR ఆరోగ్యశ్రీ పేరు 'డాక్టర్ NTR వైద్య సేవ' గా మారింది. Coverage ₹25 లక్షలకు expand అయ్యింది. Ayushman Bharat-PMJAY తో integrate అవుతోంది.
DR-NTR-VAIDYA-SEVA.answer_en: Yes, YSR Aarogyasri was renamed to 'Dr. NTR Vaidya Seva'. Coverage expanded to ₹25 lakhs. Being integrated with Ayushman Bharat-PMJAY in a hybrid Universal Health Policy.

DR-NTR-VAIDYA-SEVA.question_te: NTR వైద్య సేవ లో ఏ hospitals వస్తాయి?
DR-NTR-VAIDYA-SEVA.answer_te:
Dr. NTR వైద్య సేవ network hospitals:
• అన్ని government hospitals
• Empanelled private hospitals
• drntrvaidyaseva.ap.gov.in లో hospital list check చేయవచ్చు
• Emergency లో ఏ hospital కైనా వెళ్ళవచ్చు, తర్వాత approval
• Helpline: 0863-2259861
DR-NTR-VAIDYA-SEVA.question_en: Which hospitals accept Dr. NTR Vaidya Seva?
DR-NTR-VAIDYA-SEVA.answer_en: All government hospitals and empanelled private hospitals. Check list at drntrvaidyaseva.ap.gov.in. Emergency treatment at any hospital, approval obtained afterwards. Helpline: 0863-2259861.

NTR-BHAROSA-PENSION.question_en: What are NTR Bharosa Pension types?
NTR-BHAROSA-PENSION.answer_en: NTR Bharosa Pension (formerly Pension Kanuka) has 12+ types: Old age (60+) ₹4,000; Widow (18+) ₹4,000; Disabled 40-79% ₹6,000; Disabled 80%+ ₹10,000; Weavers/Toddy Tappers/Fishermen (50+) ₹4,000; Single Women ₹4,000; Transgender (18+) ₹4,000; ART ₹4,000; CKDU ₹10,000; Bedridden ₹15,000. Monthly on 1st via biometric door delivery.

NTR-BHAROSA-PENSION.answer_te:
NTR భరోసా పెన్షన్ amounts పెరిగాయి:
• Base pension: ₹2,750 → ₹4,000
• Disabled: ₹3,000 → ₹6,000/₹10,000
• Bedridden: కొత్తగా add — ₹15,000
• CKDU: కొత్తగా add — ₹10,000
• కొత్త categories: Traditional cobblers, Dappu artists, Transgender
NTR-BHAROSA-PENSION.question_en: How much did pension amounts increase?
NTR-BHAROSA-PENSION.answer_en: NTR Bharosa pension increases: Base from ₹2,750 to ₹4,000; Disabled from ₹3,000 to ₹6,000/₹10,000; New: Bedridden ₹15,000, CKDU ₹10,000. New categories added: Traditional cobblers, Dappu artists, Transgender.

NTR-BHAROSA-PENSION.answer_te:
NTR భరోసా పెన్షన్ documents:
• Aadhaar card
• Age proof
• White ration card
• Bank passbook
• Residential proof
• Income certificate
• Photo

Category-specific:
• Widow: husband death certificate
• Disabled: disability certificate
• Toddy tappers: cooperative registration
• ART/CKDU: treatment records
NTR-BHAROSA-PENSION.question_en: What documents for NTR Bharosa Pension?
NTR-BHAROSA-PENSION.answer_en: Aadhaar, age proof, white ration card, bank passbook, residential proof, income certificate, photo. Category-specific: death certificate (widow), disability certificate, cooperative registration (toddy tappers), treatment records (ART/CKDU).

YSR-CHEYUTHA.answer_te:
YSR చేయూత అర్హత:
• మహిళలు మాత్రమే
• వయస్సు: 45-60 సంవత్సరాలు
• SC/ST/BC/Minority
• ₹10 లక్షల income లోపు
• White/Rice ration card

Mొత్తం: ₹18,750/సంవత్సరం (₹75,000 over 4 years)

⚠️ Note: TDP government కింద ఈ scheme status uncertain.
YSR-CHEYUTHA.answer_en: Women only, age 45-60, SC/ST/BC/Minority, income below 10 lakhs, White/Rice ration card. Amount: ₹18,750/year (₹75,000 over 4 years). Note: Status uncertain under current TDP government.

YSR-CHEYUTHA.answer_te:
చేయూత documents:
• Aadhaar card
• Age proof
• Caste certificate
• Ration card
• Bank passbook
• Income certificate
YSR-CHEYUTHA.answer_en: Aadhaar, age proof, caste certificate, ration card, bank passbook.

POST-MATRIC-SCHOLARSHIP-RTF.question_te: Post Matric Scholarship (విద్యా దీవెన) అర్హత ఏమిటి?
POST-MATRIC-SCHOLARSHIP-RTF.answer_te:
Post Matric Scholarship RTF (గతంలో విద్యా దీవెన):
• ITI/Polytechnic/Degree/PG/Professional courses
• ₹2.5 లక్షల income లోపు
• SC/ST/BC/EBC/Kapu/Minority/Disabled
• Wetland < 10 acres or agricultural land < 25 acres
• 75% attendance
• No IT payee in family

Full tuition fee reimbursement!
POST-MATRIC-SCHOLARSHIP-RTF.question_en: What is Post Matric Scholarship (Vidya Deevena) eligibility?
POST-MATRIC-SCHOLARSHIP-RTF.answer_en: Post Matric Scholarship RTF (formerly Vidya Deevena): ITI/Poly/Degree/PG students, SC/ST/BC/EBC/Kapu/Minority/Disabled, income below 2.5 lakhs, land limits, 75% attendance. Full tuition fee reimbursement.

POST-MATRIC-SCHOLARSHIP-RTF.answer_te: అవును, జగనన్న విద్యా దీవెన పేరు 'Post Matric Scholarship (RTF - Reimbursement of Tuition Fees)' గా మారింది. JnanaBhumi portal (jnanabhumi.ap.gov.in) ద్వారా apply.
POST-MATRIC-SCHOLARSHIP-RTF.answer_en: Yes, Jagananna Vidya Deevena was renamed to 'Post Matric Scholarship (RTF - Reimbursement of Tuition Fees)'. Apply via JnanaBhumi portal (jnanabhumi.ap.gov.in).

CHANDRANNA-PELLI-KANUKA.answer_te:
చంద్రన్న పెళ్లి కానుక (గతంలో కళ్యాణమస్తు):
• Bride: 18+ years, Groom: 21+ years
• SC/ST/BC community
• BPL (monthly income < ₹10,000)
• Divorcees కి వర్తించదు

Amounts:
• SC/ST same community: ₹40,000
• BC same community: ₹30,000
• Inter-caste: ₹75,000
• Physically challenged: ₹1,00,000

20% ముందు + 80% తర్వాత
CHANDRANNA-PELLI-KANUKA.question_en: What is Chandranna Pelli Kanuka eligibility?
CHANDRANNA-PELLI-KANUKA.answer_en: Chandranna Pelli Kanuka (formerly Kalyanamasthu): Bride 18+, Groom 21+, SC/ST/BC, BPL income < ₹10,000/month. SC/ST: ₹40,000; BC: ₹30,000; Inter-caste: ₹75,000; Disabled: ₹1,00,000. 20% pre-marriage + 80% post.

AUTO-DRIVERS-SEVALO.question_te: Auto Drivers Sevalo (వాహన మిత్ర) అర్హత ఏమిటి?
AUTO-DRIVERS-SEVALO.answer_te:
Auto Drivers Sevalo (గతంలో వాహన మిత్ర):
• Auto/taxi/maxi cab own చేసి drive చేస్తుండాలి
• AP driving license ఉండాలి
• AP registered vehicle (valid RC, tax, fitness)
• ఒక household కి ఒక vehicle మాత్రమే

మొత్తం: ₹15,000/సంవత్సరం (₹10,000 నుండి పెరిగింది)
AUTO-DRIVERS-SEVALO.question_en: What is Auto Drivers Sevalo eligibility?
AUTO-DRIVERS-SEVALO.answer_en: Auto Drivers Sevalo (formerly Vahana Mitra): Must own and drive auto/taxi/maxi cab, AP driving license, AP-registered vehicle with valid RC/tax/fitness. One vehicle per household. Amount: ₹15,000/year (increased from ₹10,000).

DEEPAM-2.answer_te:
దీపం 2.0 (Super Six scheme):
• మహిళలు మాత్రమే (18+)
• AP permanent resident
• BPL household
• ఒకే OMC LPG connection

Excluded: IT filers, Property > 1000 sq ft, 4-wheeler, Electricity > 300 units, Land ≥ 3 acres wet / ≥ 10 acres dry

Benefit: సంవత్సరానికి 3 ఉచిత LPG cylinders
DEEPAM-2.answer_en: Deepam 2.0 (Super Six): Women only, 18+, AP resident, BPL. Excluded: IT filers, property > 1000 sqft, four-wheeler, electricity > 300 units, excess land. Benefit: 3 free LPG cylinders per year.

STREE-SHAKTI.answer_te:
స్త్రీ శక్తి (Super Six scheme):
• AP లోని అన్ని మహిళలు, బాలికలు, తృతీయ లింగ వ్యక్తులకు ఉచిత bus travel
• APSRTC: Pallevelugu, Ultra Pallevelugu, Express, Metro Express, City Ordinary
• Application అవసరం లేదు — govt photo ID చూపించండి

Excluded buses: Non-Stop, AC, Super Luxury, Interstate
STREE-SHAKTI.answer_en: Stree Shakti (Super Six): Free bus travel for all women, girls, transgender persons in AP on eligible APSRTC services. No application needed — show any govt photo ID. Excluded: Non-Stop, AC, Super Luxury, Interstate buses.

YUVA-GALAM.answer_te:
యువగళం (Super Six scheme):
• విద్యావంతులైన నిరుద్యోగ యువతకు ₹3,000/నెల
• వయస్సు: 22-35 సంవత్సరాలు
• AP permanent resident
• Degree/diploma holders
• APSSDC skill development courses తో link

Online apply: gramawardsachivalayam.ap.gov.in
YUVA-GALAM.question_en: What is Yuva Galam / Nirudyoga Bruthi?
YUVA-GALAM.answer_en: Yuva Galam (Super Six): ₹3,000/month unemployment allowance for educated unemployed youth aged 22-35, AP resident, degree/diploma holders. Linked with APSSDC skill development. Apply online at gramawardsachivalayam.ap.gov.in.

PEDALANDARIKI-ILLU.answer_te:
పేదలందరికీ ఇళ్ళు:
• Pucca house లేకుండా ఉండాలి
• ₹3 లక్షల income లోపు
• White/Rice/Antyodaya ration card
• 18+ సంవత్సరాలు
• AP resident 10+ సంవత్సరాలు

Free house (₹3-5 లక్షల subsidy)
PEDALANDARIKI-ILLU.answer_en: Must not own pucca house, income below 3 lakhs, White/Rice ration card, 18+ years, AP resident 10+ years. Free house with 3-5 lakh subsidy.

YSR-BIMA.answer_te:
YSR బీమా:
• BPL కుటుంబంలో earning member మరణిస్తే
• వయస్సు 18-70
• White/Rice/Antyodaya ration card
• ₹5 లక్షల income లోపు

Benefit: ₹5,00,000 insurance + ₹10,000 funeral expenses

⚠️ మరణం జరిగిన 90 రోజులలోపు apply చేయాలి!
YSR-BIMA.answer_en: ₹5 lakh insurance if earning member of BPL family dies. Age 18-70. Must apply within 90 days of death. ₹10,000 funeral expenses also covered.
